title: The weekly digest reports the ops sidecar, and kblog.py propose runs over it
goal: querylog.py digest prints one ops block per week from the committed ops sidecars (land, gate and test-run times, refused dones, agent runs, and the call census once it exists), and kblog.py propose has been run over the committed store so _logs.csv holds proposed rows for the operator to confirm; a second digest on unchanged inputs prints the same lines.
